; M630 S0 P0 ;FAN COVER OFF FOR NON PLANAR

; --- BLOCK 1: INITIAL SETUP & SAFETY ---
G90 ; Switch to Absolute Positioning (Printer uses exact coordinates)
G92 E0 ; Reset the extruder distance to zero
M220 S100 ; Reset overall speed to 100% (Safety reset!)
M221 S100 ; Reset extrusion flow to 100% (Safety reset!)

; — BLOCK 2: FANS  —
M107		                            ; Turn OFF primary part cooling fan (Works on ALL printers)
M106 P1 S0                                ;part fan off
M106 P2 S0                                ;aux fan off
M106 P3 S180                            ; chamber fan ON (70%)
M710 A1 S255                            ; MC board fan auto

; --- BLOCK 3: PRE-HEAT BED & WARM NOZZLE ---
M1002 gcode_claim_action :2    ; Update Bambu Screen: Heating Bed (Ignored by other printers)
M140 S80                 ; Start heating the bed
M104 S150                                 ; Pre-heat the nozzle to 150C (Soften plastic, but won't ooze)
M190 S80                 ; Wait for the bed to reach its final temperature
M1002 gcode_claim_action :7    ; Update Bambu Screen: Heating Hotend (Ignored by other printers)
M109 S150                                  ; Do not move to the next step until the nozzle is exactly 150C

; --- BLOCK 4: HOMING & CALIBRATION ---
G28 ; Home all axes (Find zero on X, Y, and Z)
G29 ; Selects Auto Bed leveling, True or False (if equipped)


; --- BLOCK 5: FINAL NOZZLE HEATING ---
M109 S235 ; Heat the nozzle to the final print temp and wait

; --- BLOCK 6: IN CASE YOU HAVE AMS ---
M1002 gcode_claim_action :0                  ; Clear status display
T0 ; Have to choose a slot (T0,T1,T2,T3] 



;===== modification: prevent ooze at travel =================
M83                                          ; extruder to relative pos
G1 E-4.0 F2700			; Retract 4mm to stop leak
G28 X Y                                      ; home xy
G90                                          ; absolute positioning

;===== HARDCODED Z-Offset for Textured PEI ==================
G29.1 Z-0.04 ;If true lowers plate 0.04
; --- BLOCK 7: PRIME LINE ---
G1 X18.0 Y18.0 Z0.35 F18000
M83
G92 E0
G1 E1.2 F300		                ; Push 1mm back + 0.2mm to prime tip
G1 X80 E6 F1000     ; VARIABLE based on grasshopper
G1 Y20 E0.5 F300
G1 X18 E7.5 F1000         ; Return line
G1 E-1.5 F300            ; Delete Slight retract
G92 E0 			   ; Add Reset extruder to 0

; FANS AFTER PRIME LINE
;M107		                            ; Turn OFF primary part cooling fan (Works on ALL printers)
M106 P1 S30                                ;control part fan
M106 P2 S150                                ;control aux fan
M106 P3 S30                            
;control chamber fan
M710 A1 S255                            ; MC board fan auto
M83

; --- BLOCK 1: RETRACT & TURN OFF HEATERS ---
M104 S0 ; Turn off nozzle heater
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed heater
M107 ; Turn off part cooling fan

; --- BLOCK 2: MOVE NOZZLE AWAY (PARK) ---
G91 ; Switch to Relative Positioning (Move based on current location)
G1 E-2 F2700 ; Pull the filament back 2mm quickly to prevent oozing
G1 Z2 F2400 ; Lift the nozzle 2mm straight up and away from the finished part
G90 ; Switch back to Absolute Positioning
G1 X10 Y220 F3000 ;Move the bed to the corner based on the grasshopper input distances

; --- COOL DOWN & SHUT OFF ---
M104 S0 ; Turn off nozzle heater
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed heater
M107 ; Turn off primary part cooling fan
M106 P1 S0                                ; part fan off
M106 P2 S0                                ; aux fan off
M106 P3 S0                                ; chamber fan off

; --- SYSTEM RESETS (Safe for all printers) ---
M220 S100 ; Reset Feedrate (Speed) to 100%
M221 S100 ; Reset Flowrate (Extrusion) to 100%

; --- DISABLE MOTORS ---
M84 X Y E ; Turn off X, Y, and Extruder motors (Leave Z engaged so bed doesn't drop)
